content:
The blue zone is between radii \(3r\) and \(4r\), so its area is
\[
\pi(4r)^2-\pi(3r)^2=7\pi r^2.
\]
The bullseye area is \(\pi r^2\), and its score is 315. Since score is inversely proportional to area,
\[
\text{blue score}=315\cdot \frac{\pi r^2}{7\pi r^2}=\frac{315}{7}=45.
\]
\[
\boxed{45}
\]
